concerns.text: Functional Requirement FR-009 mandates implementation of behavioral metrics (e.g., Task Completion Rate, Semantic Coherence, Interruption Count). No task in tasks.md addresses the computation, storage, or verification of these metrics, leaving the requirement uncovered.

Success Criterion SC-004 requires the full end‑to‑end pipeline to complete within 6 hours on a CPU‑only runner. The only runtime check is T013, which validates a sample run (<30 min). There is no task that measures or asserts the total runtime for the full dataset, so SC‑004 cannot be verified.

Functional Requirement FR-007 calls for pipeline optimization to meet the 6‑hour bound, but no task explicitly implements or validates performance optimizations (e.g., profiling, batching, streaming). This gap makes the requirement untestable.
